memories.content: The French Presidency is responsible for managing the COP21 climate conference and aims to produce a consolidated draft agreement text for negotiation. They have been working on draft texts and are aware of the need to circulate a text to national delegations before the final scheduled day of the summit.

The COP21 climate conference is taking place in Paris from November 30 to December 11, 2015. The final scheduled day of the summit is December 11, 2015. The French Presidency has the authority to circulate draft agreement texts to national delegations. The conference aims to reach a global climate agreement.
